interpretation: Default containerd pull of a vLLM image: ~144 s on c7i.2xlarge from us-west-2 ECR.
Cold-start time-to-pod-Running budget for image pull is bounded at ~150 s on this instance class.
Warm-pulled image (kubelet cache or ECR pull-through hit) costs <1 s — effectively free.
Combined with Spec F's 17.2% access ratio: lazy-pull mechanism could hypothetically pull only ~17% of bytes (~6 GB) instead of all 33 GB, theoretically reducing pull stage to ~25 s.
Two upstream variants (v0.21.0 vs latest-x86_64-ubuntu2404) differ <2% in pull time and size — picking 'smaller' upstream variant is not an optimization.
next_step_implications: Lazy-pull (SOCI/Nydus) target: ~25-40 s pull stage (vs 144 s default).
EBS prebake target: ~5-15 s (snapshot attach + mount).
Need to actually run SOCI to verify the 25-40 s estimate isn't too optimistic.
ECR pull-through cache won't help here because we're already pulling from in-region ECR; only relevant for cross-region pull scenarios.
